description: Anthony Kathol for District 27. From serving our nation to engineering healthier communities and teaching the next generation, my journey has been one of dedication, service, and faith. My vision is rooted in our shared values - improving public health, supporting education, and fostering economic growth while preserving our rich heritage and agricultural roots.
